commitResults.messageTitle: Show MESSAGE_USAGE as highlighted error hint in CommandBox
commitResults.messageBody:
When a known command (add, edit, delete, etc.) is entered with wrong
arguments and throws a ParseException, the hint label below the command
box now shows the full MESSAGE_USAGE in light red (#FCA5A5) instead of
the normal ghost text. For unknown commands, the hint is cleared.
The error hint is dismissed automatically when the user starts typing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Ghost text hint already provides sufficient command guidance.
The popup dropdown, SuggestionCell renderer, and related
DESCRIPTIONS map have been removed. Tab completion is retained.
